_comment: Ticker -> SEC CIK cache for restricted-list identity verification (verify_restricted.py). CIK is the authoritative unique issuer id; ticker substrings are not. Grow this as you resolve names: pull the full map from SEC's https://www.sec.gov/files/company_tickers.json (ticker->cik_str) or the edgar MCP (edgar-filings returns the CIK), and append. A wrong CIK defeats the check, so verify before adding. Tickers missing here fall through to 'unverified' (escalate) rather than a guess.
